term.label: spurious_protein

definition.text: A region of DNA that is predicted to be translated and transcribed into a protein by a protein detection algorithm that does not get transcribed in nature.

comments: Added as per request from GitHub Issue #478 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/478)
